newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Bidcorp mulls Bidvest unbundling.
newsitem.headline: Bidcorp mulls Bidvest unbundling.

text.p: Bid Corp Ltd said on Thursday it was considering various proposals which may result in the unbundling of its shareholding in The Bidvest group.
The companies said in an announcement that the move follows Bidvest's resolve to convert its compulsorily convertible debentures into ordinary shares on a one-for-one basis.

This conversion, which will take effect on July 1 but takes place only on September 26, would result in Bidcorp's shareholding in Bidvest reducing to about 42 percent of Bidvest's increased ordinary share capital.
"Having regard for (this), the Board of Directors of Bidcorp are considering various proposals which may result in the unbundling of Bidcorp's shareholding in Bidvest," the statement said.
Shareholders in both companies were advised to exercise caution when dealing in their instruments until a further announcement was made.
Bid Corp currently holds a 71 percent stake in Bidvest which reduces to 44 percent upon dilution.
